description: Get the webhook configuration — its URL and status. The signing secret is never returned (it would land in model context, transcripts and logs); retrieve it from the AgentPhone dashboard. Pass agent_id to get an agent-specific webhook, or omit for the project-level default.

agent_id.description: Agent ID to get that agent's webhook. Omit for project-level webhook.

name: get_webhook

outputSchema.description: The webhook configuration (signing secret always masked; retrieve it from the dashboard).

configured.description: False when no webhook is configured.

contextLimit.description: Recent messages included with each event as context.

secret.description: Always masked; the signing secret is never returned by a tool. Retrieve it from the AgentPhone dashboard.

title: Get Webhook
